description: This Java class, ConnectionPersistenceStreamingActorCreator, is responsible for creating an Akka actor that streams information about persisted connections. It provides static methods to generate Props for the actor, and helper methods to create connection tags and PidWithSeqNr objects used in streaming persistence.

classes.name: ConnectionPersistenceStreamingActorCreator
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to create Akka Props and constructs related to streaming persisted connection information.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates and returns an Akka Props object for the persistence streaming actor with specified cache size.

methods.name: createElement
methods.description: Generates a ConnectionTag from a given PidWithSeqNr object by extracting the connection ID and sequence number.

methods.name: createPidWithSeqNr
methods.description: Creates a PidWithSeqNr object using an EntityIdWithRevision that represents a connection tag.
